description: Found by the fuzzy_search example (defk-nv1): Levenshtein kernel search/4 takes 26.5ms with yields disabled vs 22.0ms for the yield: false build (~20%), so the cost is the per-iteration safepoint counter compare+branch in the innermost DP loop, not yielding (actual yields add ~5%). Proposal: for innermost loops (no nested loop) with a computable trip count (range with literal step, array generator), version the loop: if trips <= DEFK_STRIP run a copy without safepoints and add trips to defk_ticks afterwards; else run the safepointed copy. Keeps preemption for long flat loops. Done when search/4 is within ~5% of search_blocking/4 and demo section 4 still shows yielding.

comments.text: Measuring case from defk-88q: dot is now bounds-check free. Yielding 0.79 ns/elem vs yield:false 0.50 vs C 0.49. The safepoint is the whole remaining gap, because it blocks vectorisation.

title: Remove safepoint overhead from short innermost loops (loop versioning)
